note: Sell-side sentence families (Plan §11.2) with REAL examples lifted from the Bones (BeMedico) and Torino (Irmaco) IMs. Use these as structural moulds — vary the wording and the connective (see repetition-rules.json). The objective is evidence-based persuasive writing, not neutral corporate prose. Each family: when to use, the shape, and 2 real examples.

examples: BeMedico is an independent full-service distributor of medical devices in the Benelux, partnering with top global manufacturers and healthcare professionals.
Extensive portfolio of high-end single-use products such as implants, braces and injection materials, used across multiple specialties in daily care.

attribute-plus-evidence.when: Assert a quality and immediately substantiate it.
examples: An average employee tenure of around 9 years reflects strong loyalty, low turnover and a cohesive internal culture.
High recurring level of sales as a result of the single-use nature of products.

evidence-plus-implication.when: Lead with a fact, draw the investment implication.
examples: Customer loyalty is improved through loan and consignment stock models that embed BeMedico into hospital workflows and entail high switching costs for healthcare professionals.
Consumables account for the largest share of revenue, creating a recurring and predictable sales base.
Market fragmentation and rising compliance costs create opportunities for roll-up strategies.
Growing regulatory complexity increases demand for specialized product knowledge and local compliance support.
Manufacturer-trained service engineers guarantee optimal performance and long-term reliability, reinforcing customer trust.
Fully ISO-certified after-sales team offering expert maintenance and technical support for installed equipment.
Its independent position and strong local expertise make it a preferred distributor for manufacturers seeking Benelux market access.
Fragmented market with Irmaco as a unique one-stop-shop across the full spectrum of dust-explosion and process-fire solutions.
Unlike generalist distributors, the company focuses on high-margin niches requiring specialized commercial and technical expertise.
Active in specialized medical segments with structurally high margins.

historic-development.when: Show the platform built over time.
examples: Management has already driven substantial professionalization across core operations and organizational structure.
Successive expansion into adjacent specializations has transformed the business into a diversified platform.

future-opportunity.when: Point to headroom / the buyer's upside.
examples: Opportunities remain to further optimize warehousing and ERP systems to enhance efficiency and further scalability.
Further geographic expansion offers a clear route to replicate the established model in adjacent markets.

market-trend-plus-relevance.when: Structural trend -> why it helps the company.
examples: Operates in a resilient healthcare sector supported by ageing demographics, rising chronic disease burden and increasing public & private health expenditures across the Benelux.
Tighter product regulation favours distributors with established quality systems and local regulatory expertise.

metric-led.when: Open with the number that matters.
examples: High share of recurring revenue, primarily from consumables and service-linked investment goods.
More than 450 recurring customers provide a broad base for continued cross-selling.

two-part-sell-side.when: Rich highlight bullets; pair a strength with its commercial effect.
examples: BeMedico has built long-term, trust-based exclusive partnerships with internationally recognized OEMs across a range of specialized medical fields.
Long-standing and often exclusive supplier partnerships provide access to premium technologies, while local market knowledge supports effective commercialisation.
High recurring consumables exposure
Diversified specialist product portfolio
